title: 옷 가게에서 환불·교환 요청하기: 환불이 안 된다니요?
objective: Ask for a refund or exchange and show surprise with -다니요.
summary: A customer asks for a refund, learns it's exchange only, and reacts with -다니요.
setting: At the counter of a clothing store. A customer has come back with a sweater bought last week.

task.title: Ask, react, and exchange
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expression list to answer each question in Korean.

words.meaning: to give or get your money back for an item
words.example: 카드로 산 건 카드로 환불해 드려요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you paid by card, we refund the money to your card.

words.meaning: to exchange an item for another one
words.example: 색이 사진과 달라서 다른 색으로 교환했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The color looked different from the photo, so I exchanged it for another color.
Can I change the size on sale items too?

words.meaning: stock (items the store has right now)
words.example: 다른 지점에 재고가 있는지 확인해 드릴게요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'll check if another branch has it in stock.

words.meaning: defective; a product with a fault
words.exampleMeaning: The zipper is defective, so I'd like to exchange it.

words.meaning: Repeats what you just heard to show surprise or disbelief. Verbs: 안 된다니요, 끝났다니요. Nouns: 품절이라니요.
words.exampleMeaning: They're already sold out? I can't believe it.

dialogue.korean: 저기요, 지난주에 여기서 산 니트를 환불하고 싶은데요.
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, I'd like a refund for a sweater I bought here last week.

dialogue.korean: 죄송하지만 이건 할인 상품이라서 환불은 안 되고 교환만 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry, but this was a sale item, so we can't refund it. We can only exchange it.

dialogue.korean: 환불이 안 된다니요? 살 때는 그런 말씀 없으셨잖아요.
dialogue.meaning: No refund? Nobody told me that when I bought it.

dialogue.korean: 영수증 아래쪽에 적혀 있어요. 사이즈나 색상은 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: It's written at the bottom of the receipt. We can change the size or color for you.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그렇네요. 그럼 한 치수 큰 걸로 바꿔 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I see. Then please change it for one size bigger.

dialogue.korean: 그 사이즈는 지금 재고가 없어서 주문하면 일주일쯤 걸려요.
dialogue.meaning: That size is out of stock right now, so if we order it, it'll take about a week.

dialogue.korean: 일주일이나 걸린다니 좀 아쉽네요. 그래도 그렇게 해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: A whole week? That's a bit disappointing. But please go ahead and order it.

exercises: Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 손님은 왜 니트를 환불받을 수 없어요?
React with surprise using -다니요 or -(이)라니요: ① 직원: 교환 기간이 어제 끝났어요. → 손님: ____? ② 직원: 이 가방이 마지막 하나예요. → 손님: ____?
Choose the right word: 산 지 이틀 만에 이어폰 한쪽이 안 들려요. (불량 / 재고)인 것 같아요.
Fill in the blank: 이 색은 지금 ____가 없어서 다음 주에 들어와요.
Put the words in order to make a request: 바꾸고 싶어요 / 다른 색으로 / 이 셔츠를
answers: ① 교환 기간이 어제 끝났다니요? (어제 끝났다니요?) ② 마지막 하나라니요? (이 가방이 마지막 하나라니요?)
이 셔츠를 다른 색으로 바꾸고 싶어요. (다른 색으로 이 셔츠를 바꾸고 싶어요.)
